Name: Ginger Island Resort Fee
Author: homersUexusMods
Description:
You spent a fortune building that tropical resort, and for what? So the townsfolk can sip coconut drinks on your dime while you're out hoeing parsnips? Not anymore.

Ginger Island Resort Fee puts a price tag on paradise. Every evening, Willy tallies the visitors and sends you a letter the next morning detailing who paid, who didn't, and exactly how much gold now jingles in your pocket. Even young Leo, the island boy, gets to splash in the waves free of charge – he's practically part of the island, after all.

📬 Features
- Automatic Fee Collection – Each resort visitor is charged a configurable amount (0–1000g per person).
- Daily Letters from Willy – A full report arrives each morning: total guests, paying guests, free guests, and total income, plus the date at the bottom.
- Free Passes for Special People – Your spouse visits free. Optionally let your boyfriend/girlfriend in free, too. And Leo? He's always free, forever. The kid lives there.
- Flexible Mail Options – You decide whether to get letters on empty days, and even whether to get letters on busy days (the gold is always collected, even if you skip the paper).
- Respects the Resort Sign – When you close the resort via the wooden sign, the mod sees it. No visitors means no charges and (depending on your settings) no letter.
- GMCM Support – Tweak every setting through the Generic Mod Config Menu, in-game or at the title screen.
- Multi-Language – English and Simplified Chinese built in. Want to add your own language? Just translate the i18n/default.json file.

⚙️ Configurable Options
| Setting | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| Enable Resort Fee | Master switch. | On |
| Fee per Person (g) | Price per paying guest (0–1000). | 200 |
| Free for Spouse | Your husband/wife visits free. | On |
| Free for Dating | Your boy/girlfriend visits free. | Off |
| Send Mail when Empty | Get a letter even if nobody came. | On |
| Send Mail when Occupied | Get a letter when there are visitors. | On |

📥 Installation
1. Install SMAPI 4.0.0+.
2. Drop the GingerIslandResortFee folder into your Mods folder.
3. Play! A config file will be created automatically. For easy configuration, get Generic Mod Config Menu.

🌐 Multi-Language
The mod comes with English and Chinese (Simplified). Other languages fall back to English. To add a language, copy and translate i18n/default.json, keeping {0}, {1} etc. intact.

🔗 Compatibility
- Needs Stardew 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0.0+.
- Compatible with any mod that doesn't mess with the resort visitor list.
- Changing the game language updates new letters immediately.

📝 Notes
- Only NPCs listed as resort visitors are counted. Island residents (except Leo, who is explicitly free) won't appear on the list.
- Gold is added when you sleep; the letter is just the receipt.
- Turning off the master switch stops everything instantly and clears leftovers.
